seoTitle: Target Size Checker for WCAG 2.5.8 (24 by 24 CSS Pixels)
metaDescription: List buttons and links with size and position and check the 24 by 24 px minimum, including the spacing exception with a 24 px circle.
intro: Checks touch and click targets against WCAG 2.5.8, including the spacing exception.
why:
Small, tightly packed targets are hard to hit with a finger or tremor.

The tool tests each target for 24 by 24 CSS pixels. For smaller ones it applies the spacing exception: a 24 px circle centred on the target must not touch another target or another undersized target circle. Equivalent, inline, user-agent and essential exceptions need your judgement.
howTo: Enter one target per line: name, width, height, x, y.
Read the result for each target.
Enlarge or space out the failing ones.

faq.a: Yes, the target is the clickable area.

faq.q: What if I have no positions?
faq.a: Undersized targets without a position are marked review.
Yes, 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) is Level AA in WCAG 2.2.
